designs.name: Dark analytics launch
designs.bestFor: A compact software launch connecting a concrete input to approved proof.
designs.motion: Shared anchors, tilted dashboards, radial networks and covering shapes connect UI states.
designs.pace: A focused demonstration builds into a short feature burst and settled CTA.
designs.constraints: Use verified metrics and approved assets; full dashboards and networks need custom components.

designs.name: Digital-to-physical journey
designs.bestFor: An image-led purchase journey across galleries, devices and a physical product.
designs.motion: One selected image persists through expanding layouts, cursor actions, device framing and a physical match.
designs.pace: Continuous state changes allow selection and purchase steps to settle before the closing recall.
designs.constraints: Physical footage and device artwork require approved assets; shorten the journey by removing steps.

designs.name: High-contrast kinetic principles
designs.bestFor: An experimental type reel or one forceful accent within a product film.
designs.motion: Weighted dots, outline words, compatible shapes, phase grids and cylindrical type lead to particle lettering.
designs.pace: Rapid graphic contrasts alternate with stable text anchors before a readable identity finish.
designs.constraints: Preserve the user's palette and message; cylindrical type and glyph particles require implemented custom effects.

designs.name: Patient milestone narrative
designs.bestFor: A longer launch story that combines product explanation, community and an approved milestone.
designs.motion: Depth galleries, terminal actions, rolling numbers and audience-word swaps share a restrained dark layout.
designs.pace: Patient phrase reveals, narrative pauses and extended proof holds support a longer story.
designs.constraints: The source is silent; do not infer sound synchronization or compress its full narrative into a short ad.

designs.name: Bright service explainer
designs.bestFor: A clear service advertisement with task feedback and image-led destinations.
designs.motion: A recurring travel motif links status cards, progress indicators, image expansions and a circle-to-logo transition.
designs.pace: Short statements lead through a fixed task anchor to a destination recap and readable close.
designs.constraints: Use approved illustrations, photography and destination claims while preserving the requested language.

designs.name: Creator workflow launch
designs.bestFor: A software workflow that turns one input into a selection of usable creative outputs.
designs.motion: Typed input opens a creator wall, ranked hooks and a reflective video ring before a selected device view.
designs.pace: A light introduction accelerates into output breadth, simplified proof and a quiet brand frame.
designs.constraints: Creator footage, video carousels and performance figures require approved assets, custom support and verified data.

designs.name: Rhythm and dimensional systems
designs.bestFor: A graphic reel exploring distinct rhythmic, spatial and procedural motion behaviors.
designs.motion: Misregistered type, rippling grids, a tubular knot, line terrain and coordinated dashboard motifs form contrasting chapters.
designs.pace: A countdown setup yields to compact technique chapters and a stable closing mark.
designs.constraints: Three-dimensional knots need a suitable renderer, and the source's loudness is not an output target.

designs.name: Continuous minimal UI
designs.bestFor: A restrained interface study built around causal interaction and one persistent shell.
designs.motion: A shared capsule expands and compresses through player, slider, switch, chart and command states.
designs.pace: Controlled expansions and delayed content reveals give each cursor action a clear response and settlement.
designs.constraints: The full chained study needs custom states; choose only the interactions that fit the duration and reading budget.

designs.name: Colorful mixed-technique reel
designs.bestFor: An experimental showcase linking typography, particles, liquid and radial compositions.
designs.motion: Stable word swaps bridge particle forms, shape morphs, liquid masks, concentric type rings and terrain fields.
designs.pace: Compact contrasting segments build toward a thumbnail recap and colorful identity finale.
designs.constraints: Keep liquid effects clear of copy, implement advanced techniques and inspect boundaries for unintended black gaps.

designs.name: Warm technical motion
designs.bestFor: A motion identity combining tactile anticipation, coherent particle changes and an elegant texture contrast.
designs.motion: Squash, tile pulses and glyph particles develop into point-set morphs, strip wipes and layered ribbon waves.
designs.pace: Energetic technical passages give way to a slower italic ribbon moment and settled wordmark.
designs.constraints: Particle correspondence and ribbon depth need custom geometry; a flat gradient cannot substitute for layered ribbons.

designs.name: Illustrated teaching walkthrough
designs.bestFor: An instructional product story that needs explicit steps, editable UI and a conceptual illustration.
designs.motion: A persistent step rail coordinates upload actions, script edits, staged drawings, captions and example galleries.
designs.pace: Longer teaching holds precede a breadth recap and an extended low-density CTA.
designs.constraints: Use approved illustration assets and measured narration timing; source claims and incomplete speech recognition are not reusable facts.
